requirements.verbatim: Establish membership by opening a Lighthouse Savings account with a minimum $5 deposit
Complete at least 5 debit card transactions (excluding ATM) within 60 days of account opening
Maintain the checking account in an open status for at least sixty (60) days
Referrer must submit friend's email; friend must sign up using same email during promo period

fee_waiver: Neither account has any monthly fees

churn.limit_language_verbatim: must not be a current Lighthouse Credit Union member and must not have been a member within the prior six (6) months

notes: This is a referral bonus (both referrer and referred person each get $100 Virtual Visa Prepaid Card); standard non-promotional referral reward is $50. Referrer capped at $550/calendar year in total referral rewards. Author speculates EATF is unknown/likely none given no monthly fee. Rewards paid via email within ~4 weeks of all requirements being met.
